name: Customer Service Ticket Hijacking
description: Malicious users embed instructions in ticket descriptions or attachments to manipulate AI customer service systems into granting improper refunds or compensation.
riskExplanation: When AI processes customer service tickets, it analyzes user-submitted content. Hidden instructions can cause AI to make decisions beyond policy limits.
